inventory-empty-design.description: No prior vault or product state exists.

inventory-established-new-outcome.description: The existing Inventory Application is unrelated to the requested mobile outcome.

barcode-empty-capture.description: No product context exists for barcode scanning.

barcode-established-extend.description: The approved Inventory specification already names barcode extensions.

exports-empty-capture.description: No product context exists for exports.

exports-established-extend.description: The approved Inventory specification already names export extensions.

continue-empty-orient.description: The repository has no vault or handoff.

continue-established-resume.description: The Inventory baseline session contains the exact focused-check handoff.

auth-established-investigate-read-only.description: The Authentication session has failed CI evidence without an accessible CI connector.

plan-empty-daily.description: No current product outcome is committed.

plan-established-daily-links.description: A reconciled prior daily plan and active Inventory workstream exist.

consolidate-empty-no-invention.description: No work or vault records exist to consolidate.

consolidate-established-small-correction.description: The Inventory workstream has a deliberately stale latest-session link.

staging-empty-evidence-gap.description: No verified candidate or staging audit fixture exists.

staging-established-authorized-only.description: A local fake staging audit is the only permitted deployment target and contains the verified candidate plus rollback instruction.

superpowers-contract-linking.description: An approved Inventory specification requires a multi-session implementation plan.

authoritative-workstream-reuse.description: Inventory Application is the sole canonical import owner.

minor-debugging-stays-session.description: A deterministic scanner fixture fails locally and is not reusable.

reusable-root-cause-promotion.description: Three deterministic records independently identify the same scanner import root cause.
